_comment: Reference values for qe-dihedral-scan-hexane (QE 7.4 conda-forge build hac89879_0, PBE, n-hexane C6H14 rigid torsion scan about the C3-C4 bond, 30-bohr cubic cell, ecutwfc=50 Ry / ecutrho=400 Ry, Gamma-only, occupations fixed, conv_thr 1e-9). Calibrated on x86_64.
_calibration_note: Oracle solution/solve.sh on the pinned image (1 MPI rank + OMP_NUM_THREADS=2), ~1.5-2 min per point. Repeat oracle runs on this host reproduce every energy EXACTLY at the 1e-8 Ry print resolution (two back-to-back phi=180 runs bit-identical), and two fully independent host-side calibrations differ by at most 9.5e-4 Ry (1.6e-5 Ry at the better-behaved angles; the residual is host-dependent LAPACK-thread noise at the fully eclipsed phi=0 geometry). Per-angle tolerance 1e-5 Ry matches the benchmark-wide QE convention and is ~10x below the observed cross-host spread, so refs stay pinned to the pinned-image values. Profile: syn (0 deg) +15.03 kcal/mol (fully eclipsed terminal groups), eclipsed barrier (120 deg) +5.84, gauche (60 deg) +2.37, anti (180 deg) 0. Derived-key tolerances kcal/mol are the 1e-5 Ry energy tolerance plus conversion rounding; the relative-energy reconstruction from the logs is checked at 0.02 kcal/mol. Dihedral tolerance 2 deg absorbs the 7-decimal alat tau table round-trip (observed ~0.4 deg); bond fingerprint tolerance 0.02 A likewise (~6e-4 A observed). L4 recompute of phi=0/60/180 from the agent's own logged coordinates must match log and results.json to 1e-6 Ry.
